_README: Probe registry for profile.json tech_stack entries (spec boot-status-panel D8). A bare string in tech_stack is resolved here by name; an inline object in tech_stack overrides this file. kind: dependency|service|auth. cost: local|network-free|network-paid — a network-paid probe is NEVER executed at boot, it is read from .agent/memory/scratch/.stack_probes.json while younger than ttl_seconds. An entry with no probe here and no 'verify: manual' HALTS the boot panel: unverifiable is indistinguishable from missing.
